messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident detected: runtime paging spike on pool `gpu-prod-2` (alert: gpu_runtime_paging_high)
oncident-bot: First observed: 2026-03-14T22:17:56Z — see alert: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/runtime-paging?orgId=1
oncall-anna: I'm on it, paging in now. grabbing dashboards and node lists
sre-alex: I can help — initial hypothesis: kv-cache fragmentation + oversized batches causing devs to hit pagewalks. saw similar last month.
eng-runtime-jess: linking nvml readouts from the affected node (gpu-prod-2a):
```
GPU 0: 31.2 GiB total, 30.1 GiB used
GPU 1: 31.2 GiB total, 30.8 GiB used
nvmm: page faults spike ~ 18:17 UTC
process pid 22789 (runtime) rss ~ 29.6G
```
support-maya: Customer impact: two customers on Dedicated (acct=opticai, acct=longform) reported request timeouts and elevated 5xx between 22:15-22:25 UTC. Support tickets #54321 and #54322 opened.
pm-luca: Noted. Any sign of failed container restarts or OOMKilled pods?
oncall-anna: k8s shows restarts on runtime pod `runtime-9f4c` at 22:19 UTC, reason `OOMKilled` x1. Others in pool still up but with heavy page-in rates.
eng-runtime-jess: Past incident pattern: KV cache grows with many short-lived sequences and small prefixes; fragmentation leads to many small allocations and then pagewalks when new allocations happen.
sre-alex: quick prometheus queries I ran:
```
sum(rate(runtime_kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (node)
sum(rate(gpu_page_faults_total[5m])) by (node)
```
results: evictions up ~4x on gpu-prod-2a, page_faults up ~12x
logs-bot: attaching log bundle from runtime-9f4c (s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2532109876/runtime-9f4c.tar.gz)
oncall-anna: copying relevant error snippet from runtime logs:
```
2026-03-14T22:18:42Z ERROR runtime/alloc.go:132 out of memory: requested=512MB available=120MB
stack: ...
```
support-maya: Customers saw 500s and elevated latency — notifying CS to outreach. No major data loss reported.
eng-runtime-jess: temporary mitigation proposal: reduce `max_batch_size` for the heavy model routes from 64 -> 32 and increase `kvcache.eviction_aggressiveness` from 0.6 -> 0.8. That should reduce peak contiguous allocation pressure.
oncall-anna: thumbs. I'll apply a runtime config rollout to the dedicated pool and watch.
deploy-bot: starting rollout: config/runtime-radix-20260314 -> targets [gpu-prod-2a,gpu-prod-2b]; mode: canary 20% -> all
sre-alex: also recommend disabling prefix caching for the two customer routes temporarily (they're very bursty), command:
```
redwoodctl routes update --route longform/generate --kvcache.enabled=false
```
pm-luca: what's the estimated customer latency hit if we disable KV cache? we need to coordinate CS message.
eng-runtime-jess: tradeoff: maybe +15-30% token latency but avoids paging and OOMs. For dedicated customers we can message planned mitigation with minimal risk.
oncall-anna: config applied to canary nodes at 22:23 UTC. Monitoring now. Page faults dropped ~60% on canary nodes within 2 minutes.
logs-bot: uploaded updated perf plots: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/runtime-paging?orgId=1&from=now-1h
support-maya: CS: created templated note for OpticAI saying "we've applied temporary configuration changes to reduce memory pressure, your requests may see slightly higher latency; we're monitoring and will follow up". Ticket ids appended.
eng-runtime-jess: collecting GPU slab allocator metrics:
```
slab_total: 31.2G
slab_free_small: 200M
slab_free_large: 120M
allocation_frag_ratio: 0.78
kvcache_allocs: 3.2k/min
```
sre-alex: hypothesis tracker summary: (1) kvcache fragmentation causing many small free chunks -> allocation fails -> pagewalks -> OOM; (2) oversized batches increase contiguous allocation demand; (3) memory leak unlikely given short window and restarts.
oncall-anna: will run targeted diagnostic on node: `sudo perf trace -p <pid> -e page_faults` and copy outputs to logs bucket
eng-runtime-jess: also instrumenting kv cache to emit `kvcache.free_chunk_histogram` and `kvcache.max_free_run` for better postmortem signals.
pm-luca: timeline so far:
- 22:15 UTC: first alert (page fault rate up)
- 22:17 UTC: incident-bot fired
- 22:18-22:20 UTC: OOMKilled on runtime-9f4c; customers report errors
- 22:23 UTC: config canary rollout (reduced batch, eviction up)
- 22:25 UTC: page faults drop on canary nodes; customer errors decline
please confirm or add
support-maya: adding CS timeline entries for OpticAI & Longform
sre-alex: next steps for in-incident RCA: collect full `nvidia-smi -q` dump, runtime heap profile, kvcache internals dump (if available), and sample request traces for affected customers
logs-bot: runtime heap dump & nvml logs uploaded to s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2532109876/heap-nvml.zip
eng-runtime-jess: short-term remediation we committed: reduced batch size, increased eviction aggression, disabled prefix cache on two routes. Long-term: implement compaction for kvcache and better allocator to reduce fragmentation. Also consider quantized memory pools.
oncall-anna: handing off to night oncall @sre-raf (cc @sre-oncall-group). Summary: mitigations applied, metrics trending down, two customers impacted with degraded latency and transient 5xx. Logs and artifacts in s3. Please continue watching, escalate if page faults rebound.
pm-luca: thanks for the quick work. We'll schedule post-incident RCA doc tomorrow and coordinate customer follow-ups.
sre-alex: adding follow-ups:
- run load test with many short prefixes to reproduce
- add alert for `kvcache.alloc_fail_count`
- evaluate reducing default `max_batch_size` for heavy token-generation models
oncall-anna: marking incident as active -> mitigated. Will update incident tracker and move to postmortem once we have heap/kvcache dumps analyzed.
support-maya: CS outreach going out now.
eng-runtime-jess: note: we saw one edge pod that still shows fragmentation after rollout; scheduling targeted reboot for that host at 23:05 UTC.
deploy-bot: scheduled rolling restart for node gpu-prod-2a-host-07 at 2026-03-14T23:05:00Z
sre-alex: good. capture dmesg before restart and after. add to artifact bundle.
oncall-anna: handing thread to @sre-raf for overnight watch. tagging below for awareness :eyes:
oncall-anna: @sre-raf take it away — short summary in thread and links above
sre-raf: acknowledged, taking over. will keep watch and post updates. added myself to participants and will append findings
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident link: https://incident.redwood.ai/incidents/2532109876
sre-raf: quick note after takeover: page faults remain ~3x baseline but stable; no new customer errors since 22:28 UTC. continuing to monitor until 03:00 UTC.
eng-runtime-jess: for the postmortem I'll drop the kvcache histogram and allocator trace into the RCA doc. pointing to doc draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/r/rca/2532109876-draft
pm-luca: add owner for customer communications and RCA: @pm-luca
support-maya: logging final ticket updates and closing interim customer messages. will reopen if errors recur.
logs-bot: final artifact list:
- s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2532109876/runtime-9f4c.tar.gz
- s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2532109876/heap-nvml.zip
- https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/runtime-paging?orgId=1
end-of-thread: (will append postmortem link once available)
